# Sts. Peter & Paul Catholic Parish, Kiambu

Official parish information in English and Kiswahili.

## Main pages

- /readings: Daily Catholic Mass readings for the Kenya calendar, sourced from Universalis.
- /events: Parish events and reminders.
- /notices: General, wedding, and bereavement announcements.
- /jumuia: Small Christian Communities and their leadership.
- /leadership: Parish clergy and lay leadership.
- /giving: Tithe, sadaka, donations, and contributions. Payment details are only shown after parish verification.
- /visit: Postal and contact information for the parish in Kiambu, Kenya.

The parish Facebook page is https://web.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100080760517262.
